key_insight: Perfumer uses an LLM-based agent to coordinate Quantum ESPRESSO and predictive models, accelerating structural relaxation and electronic band prediction.
engineering_relevance: The framework turns natural-language requests and uploaded structures into automated relaxation-to-band workflows, reducing computation and specialist setup effort.
method: Pre-relax structures with Perfumer-relax, then refine with Quantum ESPRESSO.
Predict 12 band energies at requested wavevectors using a periodic graph neural network and latent Hermitian spectral head.
Preserve reciprocal-lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without explicitly constructing a Hamiltonian.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2.75× overall relaxation speedup across tested structures; trained on 125,153 band structures, the band model achieved 0.157 eV median per-material MAE on 2,607 held-out-composition test materials and about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores.
watch_item: Accuracy beyond the tested composition families and the 12-band output remains unestablished; consequential predictions should be checked with first-principles calculations.
paper_title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
